fn-naming-check.desc: Verifies that every private function/method name starts with `_`.
fn-naming-check.rationale: Mimics Python's convention. I like it because it makes it easy to tell at a glance whether a function is private or public.

exemptions.exemption: Methods inside `impl Trait for Type` blocks, since their names are dictated by the trait.
Methods inside a `trait` definition, since trait items carry no visibility modifier of their own.
`fn main`, since the name is fixed by the language.
